title: Ice Cream Bread
description: A fun, simple bread made from melted vanilla ice cream, self-raising flour and multicoloured sprinkles. Great for children.
steps: Preheat the oven to 205°C/185°C fan. Grease and line a standard loaf tin.
Weigh the ice cream into a heatproof bowl and melt in 10-second microwave bursts until just melted (not hot).
Use an electric whisk to beat the ice cream until fluffy. Sift in the flour and stir through quickly.
Ensure the mixture is at room temperature before stirring in the sprinkles (or they'll melt and lose colour).
Pour into the loaf tin. Bake for 30 minutes until golden brown on top.
Leave in the tin for 5 minutes before turning out on to a wire rack to cool.
notes: Slices into 8–10 pieces. Try with chocolate chips instead of sprinkles, or different ice cream flavours.
